page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.medium is an entry-level general purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is provisioned with 2 vCPUs backed by a single physical Intel Xeon 8269CY processor core running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance features 8.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Compute hardware support includes basic x86_64 vector and cryptographic instructions such as AVX, AVX-512F, AES, and FMA.

The hardware configuration includes no local storage and does not bundle dedicated GPU acceleration. Network resources are configured with a 0 Gbps baseline bandwidth, requiring network-attached storage and standard network routing to operate. Across synthetic benchmark testing, the ecs.sn2.medium yields results placing it in the lower performance quartiles, achieving a Geekbench single-core score of 911.0, a multi-core score of 1075.0, and a PassMark CPU score of 1828.27. In-memory operations show Redis SET execution handling 1.42 million operations per second alongside 1.27 GB/sec static web serving throughput.

Due to modest single-core throughput and constrained multi-threaded scaling, the instance provides low compute density. It serves cost-sensitive, non-critical operational environments where resource isolation and baseline general-purpose memory allocations are prioritized over raw execution speed, including light web servers, basic microservices, development pipelines, and low-traffic staging systems.
